entities.name: Regular input
entities.description: The field can contain missing or invalid input until Save or field blur triggers validation. Regular describes the visible state, not a guarantee that the current value is valid.

entities.name: Input valid?
entities.summary: Check the current value when validation is triggered.
entities.description: Evaluate the value and retain which event triggered this check. A valid value returns to Regular input. Missing or invalid input enters the error state associated with Save or field blur.

entities.name: Error after Save
entities.summary: Save found missing or invalid input.
entities.description: Keep the error visible while the user types, even when the value becomes valid. Save does not clear this error. Only field blur with a valid value returns to Regular input; blur with an invalid value leaves the error unchanged.

entities.name: Error after blur
entities.summary: Field blur found missing or invalid input.
entities.description: Keep the error visible while the user types, even when the value becomes valid. Save does not clear this error. Only field blur with a valid value returns to Regular input; blur with an invalid value leaves the error unchanged.

relations.label: Save or field blur
relations.description: Run validation only when an action such as Save occurs or the field loses focus.

relations.label: [valid]
relations.description: When no error is visible and validation succeeds, remain in the regular visible state.

relations.label: [invalid] Save
relations.description: This check was triggered by Save and the input is missing or invalid.

relations.label: [invalid] Field blur
relations.description: This check was triggered by losing field focus and the input is missing or invalid.

relations.label: Field blur [input valid]
relations.description: Clear the existing error only after the input is correct and the field loses focus. Typing alone or pressing Save does not take this transition.

relations.label: Field blur [input valid]
relations.description: Clear the existing error only after the input is correct and the field loses focus. Typing alone or pressing Save does not take this transition.

blocks.markdown: Save or field blur validates the current value. Missing or invalid input shows an error. Once an error is visible, it clears **only when the input is correct and the field loses focus**. Typing alone or pressing Save does not clear it; blur with invalid input keeps it visible.
